title: Practice 4: Running, swimming, climbing, crawling, dragging

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Кошка ___ (гнаться — to drive, chase (oneself)) за мышью.
exercises.why: **гонится** — present tense (3rd person singular) of гнаться: one-direction verb (many directions: гоняться).

exercises.q: Я попросил его не ___ (гнать — to drive, chase, one way).
exercises.prompt: I asked him not to drive fast.

exercises.q: Мальчик ___ (гнать — to drive, chase, one way) стадо овец.
exercises.why: **гнал** — past tense (masculine) of гнать: one-direction verb (many directions: гонять).
exercises.prompt: A boy was driving a flock of sheep.

exercises.q: Не ___ (гнать — to drive, chase, one way) меня как собаку.
exercises.why: **гони** — imperative (ты, singular) of гнать: one-direction verb (many directions: гонять).
exercises.prompt: Don't shoo me as though I were a dog.

exercises.q: Я никогда не ___ (кататься — to roll (oneself)) на скейте.
exercises.why: **катался** — past tense (masculine) of кататься: many-directions verb (one direction: катиться).

exercises.q: Я ___ (тащить — to drag, one way) тяжёлый багаж в аэропорт.
exercises.why: **тащил** — past tense (masculine) of тащить: one-direction verb (many directions: таскать).
exercises.prompt: I dragged the heavy baggage to the airport.

exercises.q: Собака ___ (гнаться — to drive, chase (oneself)) за кошкой.
exercises.why: **гналась** — past tense (feminine) of гнаться: one-direction verb (many directions: гоняться).
exercises.prompt: The dog ran after the cat.

exercises.q: Мы ___ (плыть — to swim, float, sail, one way) против ветра.
exercises.why: **плыли** — past tense (plural) of плыть: one-direction verb (many directions: плавать).

exercises.q: Лепестки ___ (плыть — to swim, float, sail, one way) по воде.
exercises.why: **плывут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of плыть: one-direction verb (many directions: плавать).
exercises.prompt: The petals are floating on the water.

exercises.q: Я больше не могу ___ (плыть — to swim, float, sail, one way).
За Томом ___ (гоняться — to drive, chase (oneself)) папарацци.
exercises.why: **гоняются** — present tense (3rd person plural) of гоняться: many-directions verb (one direction: гнаться).
exercises.prompt: Tom is being chased by paparazzi.

exercises.q: Не мешайся, не ___ (лезть — to climb, one way) не в своё дело!
exercises.why: **лезь** — imperative (ты, singular) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).
exercises.prompt: Don't stand in my way. Stay out of my business!

exercises.q: По дороге ___ (нестись — to carry on foot (oneself)) грузовик.
exercises.why: **нёсся** — past tense (masculine) of нестись: one-direction verb (many directions: носиться).
exercises.prompt: A truck was careering along the road.

exercises.q: Он всегда ___ (гнаться — to drive, chase (oneself)) за славой.
exercises.why: **гонится** — present tense (3rd person singular) of гнаться: one-direction verb (many directions: гоняться).
exercises.prompt: He is always going after fame.

exercises.q: ___ (лезть — to climb, one way) без очереди — это невоспитанно.
exercises.prompt: It's rude for people to cut in line.

exercises.q: Почему тебя ___ (тащить — to drag, one way) на буксире автобус?
exercises.why: **тащит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of тащить: one-direction verb (many directions: таскать).
exercises.prompt: Why are you being towed by a bus?

exercises.q: Ты когда-нибудь ___ (кататься — to roll (oneself)) на снегоходе?
exercises.why: **катался** — past tense (masculine) of кататься: many-directions verb (one direction: катиться).
exercises.prompt: Have you ever ridden a snowmobile?

exercises.q: Эта страна точно ___ (катиться — to roll (oneself)) в тартарары!
exercises.why: **катится** — present tense (3rd person singular) of катиться: one-direction verb (many directions: кататься).
exercises.prompt: This country is really going to the dogs!

exercises.q: Этот корабль ___ (плыть — to swim, float, sail, one way) в Геную?
exercises.why: **плывёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of плыть: one-direction verb (many directions: плавать).
exercises.prompt: Is this ship sailing to Genoa?
